overall_summary: This summary covers 5 of 6 entries received. Assessment has one high‑severity issue: quizzes are overly difficult. Teaching Quality, the most frequent theme with 3 entries, includes two medium‑severity concerns: a lecturer speaks too slowly and is seen as unhelpful. A low‑severity suggestion proposes using Examena instead of in‑person quizzes. One positive comment notes a lecturer was very helpful. Two neutral comments did not raise specific issues. Overall sentiment is mixed, with one positive, two neutral, and two negative entries.

Review the quiz difficulty levels and consider adopting Examena for online quizzes to reduce difficulty and improve accessibility.
